Independent resultant, radical and tangency checks
correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary trap [a,u],[v,w], separation and the input extremes give 0<u<v≤1, v≤1−u²−ε and u≥1+ε−v²; thus pε(u)≤0 without any equality assumption on the endpoints. At tangency write v=1−ε−u², u=1+ε−v² and 4uv=1. Then s=u+v=(√11−1)/2 and d=v−u=√(s²−1), giving ε=d(s−1)/2, the claimed radical, with positive gap d. The resultant and double-root identities were also independently reproduced. At criticality the residual quadratic in pεc=(u−uc)²H is decreasing and positive even at u=1; ∂εp≥0.9 on the required rectangle excludes all traps above threshold. Below it, strict convexity up to uc and positivity of p′ between uc and sε give the two admissible crossings; pε(3ε+ε²)>0 locates the lower crossing beyond the magnitude of the negative endpoint. Direct interval images now give exact swapping and the two derivative classifications. The even-step reachable intervals from the cycle points are nested (zero input returns each point), and their closed limit is exact by continuity and compactness. Its upper endpoint cannot be below u− by pε≤0 and cannot exceed u− by containment; the image extrema force the remaining endpoints. Taylor expansion in ε and u gives the square-root coefficient; for the critical recurrence from below the increments of 1/(uc−um) tend to B/2. This proves the all-input interval statement, not a random-measure or global boundedness result.
residual_risks: The frozen numerical description overstates upper-branch image coverage: the script checks both directed interval images for the lower branch at 23 samples; upper-branch checks are separate. This does not affect the analytical proof.
The exclusion proof is only assessed for 0<ε≤1/20, and critical slowing is one-sided in two-step return time.

value.rationale: The superstable quadratic two-cycle is a natural test case for robust support dynamics. The exact cutoff is a usable benchmark distinguishing loss of alternating confinement from band collision: even at the last admissible noise, the bands have a gap greater than 0.58. Showing that no slack trap survives and calibrating the one-sided slowdown make this more than a local normal-form computation.
residual_risks: Not a classification of every invariant set or of stochastic bifurcations under arbitrary noise laws.
